source_name: CRO Open Data Portal — Company Records
notes: Authoritative company register, launched as OPEN DATA late 2024 under CC-BY 4.0 (Open Data Directive). Verified: downloaded companies.csv.zip = 46.7 MB (193 MB csv), 817,068 companies (current + dissolved). Keyed on company_num (CRO number). Rich fields incl. NACE Rev.2 activity, eircode, status, type, registration/dissolution dates, next annual return date (nard). Daily snapshot. Bulk + CKAN API. The open spine.

source_name: CRO Open Data Portal — Financial Statements (filings index)
notes: OPEN INDEX of filed financial statements (CC-BY 4.0). Verified: downloaded financial_statements_2023.csv = 121,387 filings. Per-year CSV (2022, 2023). Each row = one filed accounts submission: company_num, submission_num, PDF file_name, received/effective/registered dates, accounts-to date. NOTE: this is the FILINGS INDEX, not the figures - the actual financial-statement PDFs are retrieved PAY-PER-CALL by registered account holders (document retrieval). Join on company_num. Structured figures need the paid PDFs (OCR/parse) or a commercial provider.

api_base_url: https://opendata.cro.ie/ (document retrieval API; registered account, pay-per-call)
notes: The actual filed financial-statement documents (PDF) are retrieved via the CRO Open Data Portal's document-retrieval feature, available to REGISTERED account holders on a PAY-PER-CALL basis. Small/micro companies file abridged accounts. Document-based PDF - not structured figures. Join via the file_name/submission_num from the open Financial Statements index. EUR.

source_name: CORE — Companies Online Registration Environment (company search)
notes: CORE is the CRO's online portal for free company name/number search and submission filing. Real-time single-company lookups; document purchase. The bulk/API needs are met by the Open Data Portal; CORE is for manual lookups + filing.

fields_observed: beneficial owners (name, nationality, month/year of birth, nature/extent of control)
notes: Register of beneficial ownership of companies (4th/5th AMLD). Access restricted after the 2022 CJEU ruling (general public access withdrawn; designated persons / those with legitimate interest). Not open bulk. Join on CRO number. Noted for completeness.

Irish VAT number (IE + 7 digits + 1-2 letters) is NOT in the CRO open data; validate/enrich via VIES (or Revenue). Validation only; does not enumerate companies. The CRO number is the open join key; VAT must be sourced separately.
National open-data portal; harvests/mirrors the CRO Open Data Portal datasets and publishes onward to data.europa.eu. Discovery hub; the authoritative source is opendata.cro.ie directly.
